entries.title: Cold sleep, a piano style for the ambient music
entries.body: Pick Cold sleep under Space in the Style choice in Settings → Appearance, or ask your first mate. A soft felt piano plays in a vast, cold room over a low drone, like a ship with everyone asleep. As your crew works, a slow heartbeat and a broken chord come in, and with three or more at work a high piano answers.

picture.alt: The Sound group in Settings → Appearance, with Ambient music on and the Style choice on Cold sleep, described as mostly piano
